title: Combinatorial optimization in geometry
note: Recasts hyperbolic-geometry realization problems (angle structures, circle patterns, Delaunay/Voronoi metric problems) as linear and convex programs; §3 develops the linear-programming duality used to certify feasibility. Source for the LP weak-duality inequality formalized sorry-free in `QOU.Optimization.lp_weak_duality` / `lp_duality_gap_nonneg`, which is the proved backing for the `duality_gap ≥ 0` assertion carried by every QOU LP/SDP-dual witness. Cited bibliographically for the abstract duality statement.PDF library/arxiv-math-9907032v1/ — joined 2026-08-16. This branch had drafted a separate entry [rivin1999] for the same paper from the library copy; main registered it independently with fuller metadata, so that draft was dropped and the library join moved here.
